card.line: Babylon was a great city on the Euphrates and the capital of Nebuchadnezzar's empire, where many people of Judah were taken into exile.

moments.title: Jehoiachin Taken to Babylon
moments.text: Nebuchadnezzar besieged Jerusalem, and King Jehoiachin surrendered. Nebuchadnezzar carried Jehoiachin, the king's family, officials, and leading men into exile in Babylon.

moments.title: Zedekiah Taken to Babylon
moments.text: After the Chaldeans seized King Zedekiah, they killed his sons before his eyes. Then they put out his eyes, bound him with bronze shackles, and took him to Babylon.

moments.title: A Letter to the Exiles
moments.text: Jeremiah sent a letter to the exiles Nebuchadnezzar had carried from Jerusalem to Babylon. In it the LORD said that when Babylon's seventy years were complete, He would restore them to their home.

moments.title: Daniel Pleads for the Wise Men
moments.text: The king was so angry that he ordered all the wise men of Babylon destroyed. Daniel answered with tact, asked his friends to plead for God's mercy, and then asked Arioch not to execute the wise men.

problems.problem: The letter moment describes a letter sent from Jerusalem but does not show it being delivered or read in Babylon.
The golden statue was set up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon, not necessarily in the city.
